business_summary: Jiangsu Feiliks International Logistics Inc. offers supply chain management services to manufacturing companies in China. The company offers comprehensive logistics services and international freight forwarding logistics services. It also provides integrated supply chain solutions by air, sea, and land; freight forwarding solutions; multimodal transport solutions; warehousing services; logistics services, including inbound, production, finished, and after sales logistics solutions; and supply chain management services. Jiangsu Feiliks International Logistics Inc. was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Kunshan, China.
